business.headline: Will RBI hike repo rate? What it could mean for homebuyers and property pricesThe meeting comes at a time when crude oil prices and global bond yields are rising, while inflation risks are also increasing. Economists are increasingly expecting a 25-basis-point hike in the repo rate.

RBI MPC begins amid rising bets on a repo rate hike to 5.5%: What experts expectThe RBI's Monetary Policy Committee has begun its October meeting with markets weighing a possible 25-basis-point repo rate hike to 5.50%. Rising crude prices, firm global yields and sticky inflation have left experts split over whether the move will begin a wider tightening cycle.

Sebi may pause closing auction rule for derivatives after expiry-day swingsSebi is likely to stop using the closing auction to settle derivatives and shift to a 30-minute volume-weighted average price (VWAP). The review follows sharp expiry-day swings, though the auction may continue for less-liquid cash-market stocks.

Sensex ends 472 points higher, Nifty above 22,500; ITC up 4%The Sensex ended at 72,382.47, up 472.77 points or 0.66%. The index opened at 72,340.95 and touched an intraday high of 72,631.93. The Nifty 50 closed at 22,555.75, up 133.80 points or 0.60%. It opened at 22,532.40 and touched a high of 22,621.80.

Jio Platforms IPO: Roadshows, strong investor interest ahead of likely Oct 28 listingJio Platforms is expected to hold an India roadshow in the week beginning October 12 after filing its red herring prospectus, says report.

Home sales slow, launches rise: Is India's housing market losing steam?Home sales are no longer rising at the same pace, even as developers continue to launch new projects. The latest numbers point to a changing dynamic in India's housing market.

Have health insurance? You may still have to pay 10% of your hospital billThe proposal, if approved, could take effect from January 1, 2027, and would cap the policyholder's contribution at Rs 5 lakh per claim. In return, customers would pay lower annual premiums, according to the report.

IndiGo hikes fuel surcharge on domestic, international flights as ATF risesIndiGo said the continuous rise in ATF costs has led it to re-calibrate fuel charges across its domestic and international routes.

UPI MDR: 83% merchants unwilling to absorb 0.4% fee, says reportA LocalCircles survey found most merchants and many users may move away from UPI once the 0.4% MDR begins on payments above Rs 2,000 from October 15. The findings sharpen concerns over higher consumer charges, a possible shift to cash and fresh calls to exempt MSMEs.

GST 2.0: Easier rules, more tax credit, no arrest powers may be on wayThe first phase focused on a major rationalisation of GST rates last year. The Council is now looking at how the system works for businesses on a day-to-day basis.

Tariffs were trade tool, now are weaponised: FM Sitharaman amid US-India trade talksNirmala Sitharaman said tariffs have become weaponised while India and the US continue trade negotiations. She said trade imbalances should be resolved through negotiated market access and reciprocal concessions.

Very very difficult to give more: Sitharaman says India-US trade talks hit plateauFinance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said India and the US have reached a plateau in trade deal talks. Her remarks indicate further concessions may be difficult even as Washington seeks other ways to reduce the trade imbalance.

Sensex, Nifty open higher after 8-week losing streak; banks lead reboundThe Sensex was at 72,322.08 at 9:22 am, up 412.38 points or 0.57%. The index opened at 72,340.95 and touched an early high of 72,402.27. The Nifty 50 was at 22,536.75 at 9:23 am, up 114.80 points or 0.51%. It opened at 22,532.40 and touched 22,564.60.

Sensex, Nifty opening: Will stock market rise ahead of RBI MPC?Indian equities are set for a higher start as GIFT Nifty rises ahead of the RBI's policy meeting. The rebound comes after eight straight weekly losses, with oil, global cues and fund flows in focus.

Anthropic eyes November IPO as filing flags existential AI risksAnthropic could begin marketing its IPO in the week of November 9, Bloomberg reported. Its filing pairs rapid revenue growth and a steep loss with unusually stark warnings about advanced AI risks.

Rs 1.5 lakh to Rs 75,000: Why this working mom chose family over a bigger pay chequeShe had a Rs 1.5 lakh-a-month job and years of experience. Then came a decision that changed what she valued in a career.

GST Council may scrap tax exemption on gold, silver, platinum imports by banksThe GST Council is likely to consider ending the IGST exemption on gold, silver and platinum imports by banks and government-nominated agencies. The proposed change would align their tax treatment with bullion exchanges as the government seeks to curb precious metal imports.

GST officers may lose arrest powers as Centre plans major enforcement reformThe GST Council is set to consider proposals to remove arrest powers from tax officers and require court approval for any arrest. The move would narrow criminal prosecution, while keeping tax recovery and penalties intact.

Adani-run Mumbai airport to redevelop T1B from Jan 2027, 9% traffic to be affectedMumbai airport will begin redeveloping the North Section of Terminal 1B from January 2027. The phased move is aimed at addressing safety concerns while limiting disruption to passengers.

CBI chargesheets RCom, ex-LIC investment chief in Rs 3,750-crore cheating caseThe document alleges that LIC suffered wrongful loss after investing Rs 1,500 crore in RCom non-convertible debentures (NCDs) in 2012. The chargesheet was filed before a Special CBI court in Mumbai.

entertainment.headline: Hanuman Ansh team prays at Kainchi Dham as devotee rush hits new high The Hanuman Ansh team visited Kainchi Dham, where Shobhinav Satya offered prayers and joined the Aarti. The visit came as the shrine saw heavy crowds and the film's director urged devotees to check conditions before travelling.

Not personal views: Sanjay Dutt folds hands, clarifies 'no peace in India' remark Sanjay Dutt, with folded hands, said his remarks on Shekhar Suman's Shekhar Tonite were part of a scripted segment. The clarification issued on Monday came after his Gandhi Jayanti episode comments triggered online debate and mixed reactions.

Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha producer alleges negative marketing, to re-release Producer Prakash Mahobiya said Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha will return to cinemas after its brief theatrical run. He alleged negative marketing hurt the film's reach and said the team wants audiences to judge it after watching it.

Splitsvilla X5 fame Dev Karan confronts tourist for filming women in McLeodganj Splitsvilla X5 fame Dev Karan Sharma confronted a tourist in McLeodganj after allegedly seeing him film women without their consent. The viral video has renewed attention on tourist conduct as police step up vigilance in the hill town.

Jailer 2 trailer X review: Rajinikanth's swag, fans spot 'Hrithik Roshan' silhouette Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 trailer has landed, setting off a wave of reactions on X. Fans praised his screen presence, highligting the returning cameos and fixated on a possible Hrithik Roshan glimpse.

Fire breaks out on Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana set in Mumbai, no injuries reported A fire broke out on Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana set in Mumbai. No one was injured and the damage was minor. The fire started in tents outside Prime Focus Studios, where the film is being shot.

Why did you need BJP to ban triple talaq?: Javed Akhtar to 'secular' Muslim leaders Veteran lyricist and screenwriter Javed Akhtar has fired back at his critics in a fiery new interview. Questioning the silence on minority reforms, he asked why secular leaders needed the BJP to ban instant triple talaq instead of fixing their own house first.

Jailer 2 trailer out: Rajinikanth as Muthuvel Pandian returns with bigger stakes The Jailer 2 trailer brings Rajinikanth back as retired jailer Muthuvel Pandian. It sets up bigger stakes with returning faces, new additions and is slated to release on October 15.

Vande Mataram doesn't hurt me, but don't impose religion: Javed Akhtar amid row Javed Akhtar is clear about where he stands on Vande Mataram. He has no problem saying the song's name or praising the country, but doesn't want to sing verses that bring religion into it. As the debate over the song's full rendition continues, Akhtar says he has the right to make that choice as an atheist.

Loved Drishyam 3 ending? Writer reveals it took 100 drafts to crack the climax Screenwriter Aamil Keeyan Khan said Drishyam: The Conclusion took over 100 drafts to crack its ending. The long process underlined the challenge of giving the Hindi franchise an original third act while preserving its core tone.

The Social Reckoning director promises a no-holds-barred Mark Zuckerberg portrayal Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning follows whistleblower Frances Haugen and reporter Jeff Horwitz as Mark Zuckerberg faces the fallout of Facebook's choices. The film revisits Facebook's role in hate speech, polarisation and democracy through a legally-vetted newsroom drama.

Will Allu Arjun's Raaka get an Oscar? Director Atlee opens up about his big dream Director Atlee said at the Baththa success meet that winning an Oscar is a personal dream, and named Raaka among the films he hopes can get there. He framed the ambition as a sign of confidence in Indian cinema and said he would keep trying until he reaches that stage.

Paying taxes since I was 20: Rakul Preet Singh denies 'malicious' IT search claims Actor Rakul Preet Singh has denied reports linking her to a recent search surrounding illegal foreign remittances and benami property holdings. She has urged media outlets to retract unverified claims, saying such reporting harms reputations and livelihoods.

Vijay Deverakonda defends Rashmika as she gets trolled for being 'too kind' Ahead of Ranabaali, Rashmika Mandanna addressed trolling over her public kindness as Vijay Deverakonda joined the conversation. Their remarks turned the spotlight on how social media can shape harsh opinions and manufactured narratives.

Actor Soori's Mandaadi to arrive on Netflix this week after Rs 150-crore haul Actor Soori's Mandaadi will begin streaming on Netflix on October 8 after a strong theatrical run. Its box-office milestones and praise from leading film personalities have amplified the film's breakout run.

AI will erase you: RGV's blunt warning to film industry amid Janhvi deepfake row Following the film industry's fierce backlash against actor Janhvi Kapoor's AI-morphed deepfake, filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma issued a blunt warning to critics on social media. He suggested that resisting artificial intelligence is a futile battle that will only leave stars behind.

Rise & Fall 2: Priyanka Chahar's gamble costs rulers Rs 32 lakh, moves to basement In the latest episode of Rise & Fall 2, TV actor Priyanka Chahar Chaudhary hit the Fortune button and took the Fall after a fiery clash with Gautam Gulati. She saved the Tower's last Rs 6 lakh, but wiped out a whopping Rs 32 lakh in the process.

Robert De Niro invites Anupam Kher home, gifts him a keepsake of their friendship Actor Anupam Kher met Robert De Niro at his New York home during his US trip. The reunion highlighted their long friendship, with Kher thanking him for the lunch and the gifted cap.

OTT releases this week: 7 best titles for your next binge From chilling horrors and gripping thrillers to action-packed dramas, celebrity reality shows and emotional stories, this week's OTT lineup brings plenty to the table.

general news.headline: Mecca Pact activated: Pakistan, Turkey to rapidly deploy troops to Saudi ArabiaSaudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey have moved to operationalise the Mecca Pact with rapid force deployment arrangements. The step comes amid persistent security threats to the kingdom from the Houthis and signals a tighter collective defence posture.

Knew he was the problem: JD Vance says flydubai co-pilot should not have flownUS Vice President JD Vance said Monday that the flydubai co-pilot accused of attacking Captain Smit Machchhar was known to be a "problem" and questioned how he was allowed to fly for an airline.

Russian drone attack sinks ship in Black Sea, 3 Indians safe, captain killedA Russian drone strike hit a Turkish-owned cargo vessel in the Black Sea, killing two and injuring crew members, including an Indian national. The attack has intensified concerns over civilian shipping safety and food trade routes in the war zone.

Haven't changed a comma, EC sources clarify after SC's Form 6 remarkThe Election Commission said it had not altered the original Form 6, while acknowledging that an additional declaration page was added during SIR under a protocol formulated in Bihar last year. The clarification came as the Opposition turned up the heat after CJI Surya Kant said the Supreme Court had not approved any modified Form 6.
Commission Impossible: Gyanu Must GoCEC Gyanesh Kumar must sack himself. Not because the allegations are true, but because he allowed the allegations to come up in the first place.

Cong-CJP clash? Rahul seeks united fight, Dipke's outfit attacks liberal ecosystemCongress leader Rahul Gandhi's bid to bring disparate protests onto his common Satyagraha platform has coincided with a public spat between his party leaders and the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP). Though CJP leaders didn't name the party, Congress leaders reacted, and made it obvious.

Invited for talks, then arrested: Protesting nurses accuse Vijay govt of betrayalNurses are demanding a monthly salary of Rs 45,000, equal pay for equal work, permanent employment, job security and payment of pending incentives.

Video: Fire brigade tanker used to wash Gujarat MLA's home, row eruptsA viral video shows a municipal fire brigade tanker washing Gujarat MLA Bachubhai Khabad's residence in Dahod. The footage has prompted an inquiry into whether government machinery was used for a private purpose.

Sitharaman's speech disrupted, Cong claims anger, Chandrababu says enthusiasmUnion Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's speech at an event in Andhra Pradesh was briefly disrupted due to shouting by some in the crowd. A clip of the incident has sparked a political clash, with the Congress claiming it was public anger over jobs and Andhra CM Chandrababu Naidu terming it enthusiasm.

UCB Acquires Former The Cube Hotel in £15m Hospitality Education Investment ProgrammeThe acquisition of the former The Cube Hotel and Marco Pierre White restaurant marks the first stage of UCB's wider hospitality investment programme. The site is being redeveloped into a 52-bedroom hotel and restaurant in one of Birmingham's most distinctive landmarks.

British Airways flight descends 28,000ft, returns to London after mid-air emergencyBritish Airways Flight BA295, operating from London Heathrow to Chicago O'Hare, squawked 7700, the international emergency transponder code, while flying over Ireland.

Hardeep Puri, 7 other sitting MPs dropped from BJP's Rajya Sabha poll list for UPThe new list includes three OBC candidates, two Scheduled Caste candidates and three from the general category. Two of the eight nominees are women.

What do you gift the Swiss President? PM Modi chose 3 Indian cheesesPrime Minister Narendra Modi presented Swiss President Guy Parmelin with some rather interesting gifts. And, of course, India was on the front foot with three award-winning Indian cheeses taking centre stage.

Pak mulls emergency rule in PTI-ruled KP, Imran's party marches to test IslamabadThe Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) has begun its long march to Islamabad after talks with the Centre collapsed. As protesters move towards the capital, the government is weighing governor's rule or emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, accusing the provincial government of not doing enough to tackle terrorism and cooperate on security.

Tukaram Mundhe makes it to The New York Times front page as a 'rock star'The New York Times has featured Tukaram Mundhe on its front page under the headline, "In India, a Food Inspector Is a Rock Star", with the strap, "Diners revere him and owners fear him."

Mercedes-Maybach S 580e launched in India at Rs 3.35 croreMercedes-Benz has launched the Maybach S 580e in India at Rs 3.35 crore, combining Maybach's signature luxury and craftsmanship with a plug-in hybrid powertrain and nearly 100km electric range.
Lose your job, bear your pain because AI must be allowed to remake the worldSam Altman wants the world to suffer a few bad things for the collective good that AI promises to humanity. He is right.

Almost no locomotives left: How Russia's strikes are choking Ukraine's lifelineUkraine is seeking locomotives and funds as Russian strikes hammer its railways, ports and industry. The damage is choking exports, shrinking tax revenue and raising the cost of sustaining the war.

Indian man led neo-Nazi ring, abused minors on Discord, faces life term in FranceIndian national Rohan Rane, who was on a student visa in France, allegedly ran a Discord group that coerced girls as young as 12 into sexual acts and self-harm. French investigators linked around 20 victims to Rane, while his wider CVLT network allegedly targeted around 100. He faces life in jail if convicted.

Amid harassment charges, Delhi Police issues guidelines for journos covering stirDelhi Police's new guidelines for journalists came amid allegations by women journalists covering the recent protest at Jantar Mantar that they were groped and assaulted by police personnel.

Not personal views: Sanjay Dutt folds hands, clarifies 'no peace in India' remarkSanjay Dutt, with folded hands, said his remarks on Shekhar Suman's Shekhar Tonite were part of a scripted segment. The clarification issued on Monday came after his Gandhi Jayanti episode comments triggered online debate and mixed reactions.

Jailer 2 trailer out: Rajinikanth as Muthuvel Pandian returns with bigger stakesThe Jailer 2 trailer brings Rajinikanth back as retired jailer Muthuvel Pandian. It sets up bigger stakes with returning faces, new additions and is slated to release on October 15.

Fire breaks out on Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana set in Mumbai, no injuries reportedA fire broke out on Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana set in Mumbai. No one was injured and the damage was minor. The fire started in tents outside Prime Focus Studios, where the film is being shot.

25-year-old gym trainer killed after a fight at client's flat during overnight stayA gym trainer was allegedly beaten to death after an argument inside a client's Bengaluru flat. Police have detained four people as investigators probe the personal dispute behind the killing.

sports.headline: Kuldeep Yadav a match-winner, his return to form is great news for India: Morne Morkel IND vs WI, 1st T20I: Speaking ahead of the series opener against the West Indies in Lucknow on Tuesday, India bowling coach Morne Morkel heaped praise on Kuldeep Yadav, saying India can breathe a sigh of relief with the spinner finding his rhythm. Kuldeep took seven wickets in the ODI series at an economy rate of 5.56.

India have good potential, but Uruguay are focused on their game: Lucas Torreira Lucas Torreira praised India's potential and thanked the country for the warm welcome ahead of Uruguay's match against India. He also said Uruguay are focused on their own game and want to learn under coach Diego Forlan.

After Asian Games gold rush, India stars set to shine in Archery Premier League 2 India's Asian Games archery heroes will turn franchise rivals as APL Season 2 begins in Hyderabad on October 8. With 48 Indian and international archers across six teams, the league will offer a fresh test after India's nine-medal haul in Aichi-Nagoya.

Brazil defeat still fresh, Khalid Jamil wants sharper India against Uruguay India are looking to respond after their 4-0 defeat to Brazil, with Khalid Jamil demanding sharper concentration and fewer costly mistakes against Uruguay as the national team closes a demanding three-match international window.

Sahibzada Farhan named Pakistan skipper for Sri Lanka T20Is, Babar Azam left out Pakistan have appointed Sahibzada Farhan captain for the three-match T20I series against Sri Lanka and left Babar Azam out of the squad. The announcement also brings Razaullah into both white-ball squads and marks Naseem Shah's return after injury.

Daniil Medvedev pays for rage as he injures fan, gets disqualified from China Open Daniil Medvedev was disqualified from his China Open semifinal against Novak Djokovic after hitting a ball into the stands and injuring a spectator. Djokovic advanced to the final with his perfect 33-0 Beijing record intact and will face Alex de Minaur for a seventh China Open title.

Wait, watch, learn: Morkel backs Sooryavanshi's growth despite limited game time India vs West Indies, T20Is: Morne Morkel says limited game time will not slow Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's development, with the India bowling coach stressing the value of training, observing and learning alongside experienced players.

India are dangerous in T20Is, but West Indies won't back down: Akeal Hosein Akeal Hosein acknowledged India's dangerous T20I firepower but insisted West Indies will not back down as the five-match series begins in Lucknow. With a difficult record in India and a formidable top order to contain, the visitors are banking on better planning and execution.

Build from the roots: Diego Forlan's blueprint for Indian football Diego Forlan knows Indian football from both sides of the touchline, having played in the ISL in 2016 before returning as Uruguay's coach. Ahead of Tuesday's clash in Kolkata, he believes India's next generation needs stronger academies and more football.

Pakistan Champions pull out of World Championship of Legends after 2025 fallout Pakistan Champions have pulled out of WCL Season 3 after the PCB upheld its decision to deny NOCs to the team's players. The decision stems from the India-Pakistan boycott controversy that overshadowed the 2025 edition of the tournament.

Akari Fujinami loses for first time since 2017. Now she vows to win Olympic gold Akari Fujinami's 155-match winning streak ended at the Asian Games, but the Japanese star has vowed to bounce back with Olympic gold at Los Angeles 2028. The Paris 2024 champion overcame her fear to win bronze after suffering her first defeat since 2017.

What is Mission Olympic Wing? Indian Army's programme behind nurturing talentThe Indian Army's Mission Olympics Wing has built a structured pathway for identifying and nurturing sporting talent. Its system has helped produce a strong contingent of medal-winning athletes, with Army sportspersons winning 20 medals for India at the 2026 Asian Games.

Brisbane Olympics 2032: Pink cockatoo beats kangaroo to become Games emblemBrisbane 2032 has unveiled a pink cockatoo-inspired emblem, chosen over the kangaroo and other Australian animals to represent Queensland and its cultural identity. The emblem was leaked ahead of its official launch, while the Games' separate mascot will be revealed closer to the 2032 Olympics.

Report card: The best and worst of India's Asian Games campaignIndia finished fourth at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games with 85 medals as a late surge lifted the campaign. Strong displays in wrestling, archery, boxing and hockey contrasted with setbacks in badminton and tennis.

No India comeback, but Bhuvneshwar Kumar gets captaincy call at Hong Kong SixesBhuvneshwar Kumar will captain India at the Hong Kong Sixes from 30 October to 1 November. He will lead a power-packed squad, which also has the likes of Krunal Pandya and Shashank Singh.

Inside coach Gambhir's chat with Vaibhav Sooryavanshi over his T20I selectionGautam Gambhir has revealed what he told 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi about waiting for his T20I opportunity, insisting India cannot be swayed by social media noise while defending continuity with Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma.

AFC Nations League explained: What it means for India's FIFA World Cup dreamThe AFC's proposed Nations League could bring Asia more meaningful fixtures, a clearer route towards the World Cup and regular competitive exposure. But its ambitious structure also raises concerns over travel, costs, calendar congestion and whether India can benefit from it.

Watch: Fast bowler's bouncer goes over wicketkeeper's head for a sixA bizarre bouncer in the Canada Super60 appeared to clear the boundary for a six after flying over the wicketkeeper's head. How short are the boundaries of these franchise leagues?

Indian tennis enters a dark phase as safety net disappears in NagoyaIndia's proud Asian Games tennis tradition hit a 40-year low in Aichi-Nagoya as the country returned without a single medal. The selection controversy, retirement of its golden generation and lack of successors have exposed the deep decline of Indian tennis.

India win men's Asian Games hockey gold again. But was it really special?The Indian men's hockey team won the Asian Games gold again. However, the feeling of the victory doesn't match up to the one achieved by the women's side. A lot of external noise, coupled with on-field errors made India's win in Nagoya feel a bit subdued.

PM Modi congratulates Indian contingent after fourth-place Asian Games finishPrime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the Indian contingent on Sunday for its spirited performance at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, praising the athletes for their determination and passion after India finished fourth in the medal standings with 85 medals.

LA Olympics less than two years away, Abhinav Bindra calls for urgent actionAbhinav Bindra has urged India to sharpen its high-performance planning after the Asian Games, stressing that preparations for the Los Angeles Olympics must begin immediately with a stronger focus on long-term athlete development and support.

Kumkum, Sujeet named first winners of Jaspal Rana, Raja Randhir Singh awardsIndian archers and wrestlers were among the standout performers at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, with 17-year-old Kumkum Mohod and Sujeet Kalkal earning special recognition as the inaugural recipients of the Jaspal Rana Award and Raja Randhir Singh Award, respectively for their gold-medal-winning performances.

Virat Kohli's No. 3 successor? Jaffer backs Indian left-hander to replace himFormer India opener Wasim Jaffer has backed Tilak Varma to succeed Virat Kohli at No. 3, citing the young left-hander's versatility and strong first-class record as India looks ahead to the 2027 World Cup.

Novak Djokovic breaks Nadal's record with epic comeback win vs Alexander ZverevNovak Djokovic fought back from a set down to beat Alexander Zverev 4-6, 6-4, 6-4 and reach the China Open semi-finals. The win took Djokovic to 32-0 in Beijing, surpassing Rafael Nadal's record of 31 consecutive wins at a single tournament.

Shoaib Akhtar dismisses Pakistan chief selector reports, cites mother's adviceFormer Pakistan pacer Shoaib Akhtar has dismissed reports linking him with the Pakistan chief selector's role, saying he has no interest in joining the PCB and will stick to his mother's advice to stay away from the board.

Pakistan cricketer follows mother's footsteps, retires to become match refereeKainat Imtiaz has retired from international cricket after a 13-year career and is embarking on a new journey as a match referee. The former Pakistan fast bowler is following in the footsteps of her mother, Saleema Imtiaz, while balancing cricket with motherhood.

India deserved this historic Asian Games gold: Women's hockey captain Salima TeteIndian women's hockey captain Salima Tete said her team always believed it could go all the way at the Asian Games, and that belief paid off as India held on to a 1-0 win over China to end a 44-year wait for gold and secure a place at 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

Aryna Sabalenka suffers yet another setback, makes shock exit at China OpenAryna Sabalenka's difficult 2026 continued as she suffered a shock 6-4, 6-3 defeat to Nikola Bartunkova at the China Open. The loss extends Sabalenka's title drought since March, with the Belarusian also losing the No. 1 ranking and failing to win a Grand Slam this year.

Max Verstappen beats Antonelli to win F1's rain-delayed Bahrain Grand PrixRed Bull's Max Verstappen won the rain-hit Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia on Sunday, claiming his first win of the season after the race was delayed by more than 90 minutes due to heavy rain at the Sepang International Circuit.

Rafael Nadal rolls back the years, beats Team Andy Murray in exhibition matchRafael Nadal rolled back the years as Team Nadal beat Team Murray 4-3 in a nostalgic exhibition at the Rafa Nadal Academy's 10th anniversary celebrations. Nearly 2,000 fans watched Nadal reunite with Andy Murray and other tennis legends in an evening filled with competitive tennis, memories and emotion.

NCERT deletes Azad Pak, adds China's aggression reference in Class 12 textbookThe NCERT has made final changes to its Class 12 Political Science textbook syllabus for the upcoming academic year, including a revision in reference to India's border situation with China, Azad Pakistan, Article 370 and more.

Forest fires surge tenfold from 2004 to 2017: Causes, impact and preventionAmidst a relentless surge, intense forest fires are now multiplying tenfold, casting a menacing shadow over our flora and fauna. Year by year, their fiery grip tightens, threatening ecosystems far and wide, now extending their reach to impact human lives.

Fresh plea in Supreme Court to recall NEET results, reconduct examsA fresh petition has been filed in the Supreme Court to recall the National Entrance cum Eligibility Test - Under Graduate (NEET-UG) 2024 results and re-conduct fresh examination after discrepancies in the declared results.

NTA issues clarification after NEET result controversy over toppers, high cut-offIn a detailed statement, the National Testing Agency (NTA) said that the increase in cut-off and number of toppers in the NEET-UG reflect the competitive nature of the exam and maintained that the test's integrity has not been compromised.

Exclusive: Arvind Kejriwal claims 'BJP succession war, PM backing Amit Shah'Speaking exclusively to India Today TV, Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal claimed that there is a "succession war" within the BJP. 4 medical students arrested in Bihar for appearing as proxies for NEET aspirantsFour MBBS students who appeared in place of NEET aspirants in the medical entrance exam were detained in Bihar's Purnea.

Left sweeps JNU students' polls, Dhananjay is first Dalit presidentThe Left swept the Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls, winning all four posts and trouncing the RSS-affiliated ABVP. JNU students' body election on March 22 after 4 yearsThe Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls will take place on March 22, more than four years after the last elections were held in September 2019.

UP 12th board exam math, biology papers leaked on WhatsApp, complaint filedThe mathematics and biology question papers for the Uttar Pradesh class 12 board exam were allegedly leaked on a WhatsApp group.

Bihar University: Lessons of the pastPoliticians in Bihar have long been notorious for meddling with higher education. Rules have been changed and appointments made under their pressure - all under the ruse of "creating a better academic climate".
